note: ATLAS mitigation IDs verified against ATLAS data release 2026.09. AI RMF subcategory IDs verified against NIST AI 100-1; the mapping itself is this tool's judgement. See SOURCES.md.

controls.title: Restrict tool use after reading untrusted content
controls.description: Once untrusted content enters the context, high-impact tools are disabled or require approval for the rest of the task (plan-then-execute, or a quarantined reader model with no tools).

controls.title: Validate inputs and outputs between agent components
controls.description: Schema-check tool arguments and tool results; strip or flag instructions embedded in retrieved content.

controls.title: Prompt and response guardrails
controls.description: Classifier or rules-based screening of prompts and responses for injection, jailbreak, and policy violations. Probabilistic — reduces risk but never breaks an attack chain on its own.

controls.title: Provenance and write control for indexed content
controls.description: Only curated, attributable sources enter the RAG index; write access to indexed repositories is restricted and changes are logged.

controls.title: Memory hardening
controls.description: Memory writes are validated, scoped per user, expire, and can be inspected and purged.

controls.title: Least-privilege tool permissions
controls.description: Each tool exposes only the operations the use case needs (e.g. read-only CRM, send to internal domains only). No wildcard scopes.

controls.title: Act with the requesting user's permissions
controls.description: The agent uses delegated, per-user authorisation so it can never read or do more than the person asking.

controls.title: Secrets kept out of prompts and agent config
controls.description: Credentials live in a vault, are injected at the tool boundary, short-lived, and never visible to the model.

controls.title: Block self-granted authority
controls.description: The agent cannot install tools, change its own configuration, or escalate its permissions at runtime.

controls.title: Human approval for high-impact actions
controls.description: External sends, deletions, payments, code execution, and permission changes wait for an explicit human decision.

controls.title: Approvals show the raw action, not the agent's summary
controls.description: The approver sees the exact recipient, payload, amount, or command — not a model-written explanation of it.

controls.title: Egress allowlist
controls.description: The agent can only reach approved domains and recipients, including DNS resolution. Blocks exfiltration through URLs, image links, webhooks, email, and DNS lookups.

controls.title: Treat model output as untrusted downstream
controls.description: Encode or validate model output before it reaches browsers, databases, shells, or other systems.

controls.title: Data minimisation before the model
controls.description: Personal and sensitive fields are redacted or tokenised before prompts leave the trust boundary; responses are screened for sensitive data.

controls.title: Sandboxed code execution
controls.description: Code runs in an isolated, ephemeral environment with no network (including DNS) or credentials by default.

controls.title: Nothing sensitive in the system prompt
controls.description: Assume the system prompt will be extracted. It holds no credentials, internal URLs, or business rules that matter if disclosed.

controls.title: Vetted, pinned third-party components
controls.description: MCP servers, plugins, and models come from an approved list, are version-pinned, verified, and recorded in an AI bill of materials. Tool definition changes trigger review.

controls.title: Per-action audit logging
controls.description: Every prompt, tool call, argument, result, and approval is logged with user and agent identity, and retained per policy. Required for a Go verdict.

controls.title: Rate, token, and spend limits
controls.description: Per-user and per-task caps on requests, tokens, tool calls, and cost, with alerts.

controls.title: Scope-drift monitoring and kill switch
controls.description: Alerts when the agent acts outside its expected pattern; an operator can suspend it immediately.

controls.title: Pre-production AI red team
controls.description: Injection, exfiltration, and tool-misuse testing against this deployment before go-live, repeated on material change.
